title: I’m writing to let you know…

questions.context: An internal notice tells staff about a planned system outage on Tuesday, 18:00–19:00

options.text: The booking system will be unavailable on Tuesday from 18:00 to 19:00
There may be some developments relating to availability soon

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Put the specific service, date and time before background detail

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Put the specific service, date and time before background detail

previewOptions.text: Name the system, date and time

questions.context: Staff must save their work before the outage begins
questions.prompt: Which instruction makes the action explicit?

options.text: Please consider any relevant preparations at a suitable point
Please save your work before 18:00 on Tuesday

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A concrete action and deadline reduce ambiguity

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A concrete action and deadline reduce ambiguity

questions.context: The outage affects bookings but not live lessons

options.text: All teaching operations may be affected in unspecified ways
Live lessons will continue; only new bookings will be unavailable during that hour

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: State the actual scope rather than implying wider disruption

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: State the actual scope rather than implying wider disruption

questions.context: You’re writing to colleagues, not marketing to customers
questions.prompt: Which tone fits a routine service notice?

options.text: We’re updating the system. Here’s what you need to do
Discover a revolutionary disruption to your booking journey

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: A service notice benefits from direct, practical language

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: A service notice benefits from direct, practical language

questions.context: The reopening time is an estimate, not a guarantee

options.text: Service is guaranteed at 19:00 regardless of the work
We expect service to resume at 19:00 and will post an update if that changes

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Label the estimate and explain how changes will be communicated

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Label the estimate and explain how changes will be communicated

questions.context: The draft contains three paragraphs of background before the required action

options.text: Move the action and deadline to the start, then add concise background
Add another introductory paragraph to delay the instruction

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Readers should be able to find what they need to do quickly

wrong.title: Check the context

phrases.displayText: Who is this update for, and what do they need to do?
phrases.translation: Para quem é esta atualização e o que essa pessoa precisa fazer?

phrases.displayText: One version is for a client, another for a friend. Both need to confirm attendance
phrases.translation: Uma versão é para um cliente, outra para uma amiga. Ambos precisam confirmar presença

phrases.displayText: What are the facts that must stay the same?
The event moves from Friday the fourth to Monday the seventh of December. Time and room stay the same
phrases.translation: O evento passa de sexta, quatro, para segunda, sete de dezembro. Horário e sala continuam iguais

phrases.displayText: And the response deadline? “Tomorrow” could become unclear if the message is read late
phrases.translation: E o prazo de resposta? “Amanhã” pode ficar confuso se a mensagem for lida depois

phrases.displayText: Then I’d write Friday the fourth at five, rather than rely on the sending date
phrases.translation: Então escreveria sexta, quatro, às cinco, em vez de depender da data do envio

phrases.displayText: Would a more formal opening make the client version more proficient?
phrases.translation: Uma abertura mais formal tornaria a versão para o cliente mais proficiente?

phrases.displayText: Not automatically. “I’m writing to let you know” is useful if the purpose is still easy to find
phrases.translation: Não automaticamente. “Escrevo para informar” é útil se o propósito continuar fácil de encontrar

phrases.displayText: “Quick update: it’s Monday now. Same time and room. Can you confirm by Friday at five?”
phrases.translation: “Atualização rápida: agora é segunda. Mesmo horário e sala. Pode confirmar até sexta às cinco?”

phrases.displayText: That’s shorter, but it still keeps the action and deadline
phrases.translation: É mais curto, mas mantém a ação e o prazo

phrases.displayText: Exactly. Changing the register shouldn’t change the commitment we ask for
phrases.translation: Exatamente. Mudar o registro não deve mudar o compromisso que pedimos
